description: Get a live, non-executing swap quote from the Orkid solver network (gasless via Permit2, MEV-protected). Same-chain swaps on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Unichain, BSC, Robinhood. The response includes a swapUrl — send the user there to sign; the agent never touches keys. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key header (key at orkidlabs.xyz/partner) or $0.002 USDC/call via x402.

chain.description: Chain name or id: base | ethereum | arbitrum | unichain | bsc | robinhood (polygon is bridge-only)

from.description: Input token symbol (e.g. USDC) or contract address

to.description: Output token symbol (e.g. WETH) or contract address

name: orkid_quote
title: Orkid Swap Quote
